band_label.fit_to_quote: No slip, or at most two that mislead no one

band_label.many_errors: Many errors that may change the meaning: 3 or more on the page
band_label.from_elsewhere: A span from somewhere else: invented, recited, or another leaf
band_label.not_this_page: Not this page's text at all (fidelity 1)
band_label.no_text_served: The page serves no transcription (never read, empty, or marked unreadable)
band_label.unjudged: Not judged: the image would not fetch or the reply never parsed
